title: Ledrix Admin Launch Tour
lines: Welcome to Ledrix CRM — the multi-tenant sales platform built for agencies and closers.
This is the Admin dashboard — your command center for leads, orders, sellers, and payments.
Every workspace is tenant-isolated, so your brands, data, and clients stay separate and secure.
In Leads, capture inbound prospects and assign them to the right seller in seconds.
Orders connect every deal to payment status — no more juggling spreadsheets and separate tools.
The Clients section gives you full visibility into every customer in your workspace.
Manage Sellers and Brands under one tenant — built for multi-brand agencies.
Track Payments tied directly to CRM orders — complete revenue clarity from lead to paid.
Ledrix Admin helps you capture leads, close deals, and scale your agency.
Start your free trial today at ledrix dot co.
